Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We are getting ready to run a SIG-lite + CAIQ intake as part of our procurement for the next quarter. Can we set up a short kickoff to go over scope, timing, and a few evidence requests? Our legal/compliance team would like to get a baseline list of artifacts (logs, retention policy, SOC2 report timeline) ahead of the call so they can prioritize.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm which controls are covered under Redwood's SOC2 (expected timing for latest report)
- Walkthrough of logging/retention for inference requests and customer-managed encryption options
- A short Q&A on data residency and VPC/private deployment patterns

Would Thursday morning PST work? If so, please propose a calendar invite and any pre-read we should review.

Thanks,
Alex Greene
Security & Risk | AtlanticBridge

Subject: Re: AtlanticBridge security intake — artifact examples

Alex,

Quick note to align on the evidence formats we find most useful to speed review:
- Logging samples: one week's worth of anonymized tokenized request logs (CSV) + schema and TTL notes
- SOC2: If you have a current Type II, a redacted report is fine; otherwise, we can provide our SOC2 snapshot and point people to the auditor contact
- Retention policy: short PDF or text snippet that states retention windows for telemetry vs. customer content

I'll bring example anonymized log rows and our log-export playbook to the call. Also tagging Jonas for encryption/KMS questions — Jonas, can you prepare two slides on KMS integrations and HSM options (3–5 bullets)?

Marissa Cole
Security Intake Lead | Redwood Inference
